## Emberfall: The Runeblade

A small 3D fantasy action RPG set in a haunted forest. Defeat the three Mossbound Wardens, gather floating wild runes, and use your enchanted sword and arcane burst to survive.

content.text:
Built **Emberfall: The Runeblade**, a playable 3D fantasy RPG in `index.html`. Explore the forest, defeat three Mossbound Wardens, collect runes, and use your magical sword and arcane burst.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to slash, Q for an arcane burst. Touch controls are included for mobile.

I also added gameplay and setup notes to `README.md`. The game loads Three.js from jsDelivr, so it needs an internet connection. I verified the scene renders and the controls respond in-browser.
